chapters.reason: The paper proposes adapting autoregressive models to build diffusion models, demonstrating connections between AR and diffusion objectives, which aligns with hybrid AR-diffusion integration.
The paper focuses on diffusion language models, which typically operate on continuous embeddings with Gaussian noise, though it does not explicitly detail the embedding-based formulation.

The approach converts pretrained AR models (GPT-2, LLaMA) into diffusion models via continual pre-training, resembling training-induced hidden-state conversion from Transformers to other architectures.
